resources.string: Companion proof-of-concept for authorized Kesho Bank training use only. Demonstrates vuln #16: PinEntryActivity never calls setFilterTouchesWhenObscured(true), so a FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE overlay from this app can sit on top of it and taps still pass through underneath.
Then switch to Kesho Bank, open PinEntryActivity, and line the decoy banner up over the Submit button. Taps on the decoy still confirm the PIN underneath.
🎁 Tap to claim your free airtime!
